note: Music hooks for Prod. Only the calls below are approved uses. Names resolve in the SigmAudio runtime; stable IDs are given too.

station.piece: One Note Apart: Crossing, Explore state only
station.approved: Skyiah 2026-10-10 (loved the exploration music) and 2026-10-14 (placed on the station)

calls.when: the player is in the station (and not in a Crossing or the Freight Bay)
the player leaves the station for a space with its own music

doNotCall: set_parameter(threat|style): drives One Note Apart's Combat, Climax and Resolution states, which are reserved for a hacking/technical-puzzle use and are not approved for the station

freightBay.piece: The Freight Bay, four parts (Shunter encounter)

calls.when: the player enters the Freight Bay
the Shunter enters HORN (it noticed the player and sounds its horn)
the player leaves the Freight Bay

onStateChanged.Entry: play res://audio/music/freight_bay_stingers/freight_bay_entry_stinger.wav once, on the Music bus
onStateChanged.Victory: play res://audio/music/freight_bay_stingers/freight_bay_victory_stinger.wav once, on the Music bus

freightBay.notAuthored: There is no route from Combat back to Exploration except victory. See README, 'Open points for Prod'.

buses.Music: both cue players and the stinger player
buses.SFX: the Shunter's warning horn and all gameplay sounds; never routed through the Music bus
